text:
maya: hi folks — quick: where should i post questions about my dev setup vs product questions? also the onboarding bot keeps DMing me at weird hours, can i change that?
jordan (people-ops): welcome, maya! :wave: short answer: access/setup -> #eng-infra or DM the IT alias, day-to-day role/process -> #new-hires or your team channel, product questions -> #product or the specific product team channel.
maya: perfect, thanks. for the bot — it sent a checklist at 6am my time :grimacing: is there a way to change frequency or silence DMs?
onboard-bot: Tip: send `snooze 7d` to pause reminders for a week, `snooze 1h` for short breaks, or `help frequency` to change cadence. You can also mute the bot in the DM header.
kai (it): if you're getting notifications outside your work hours, check the bot settings in the app view (click bot name -> settings). Also confirm your timezone in Slack profile.
maya: timezone was wrong indeed, fixed that. one more: VPN to access intra gives me 403 when opening from Slack link — should that go to #eng-infra?
olivia (eng): yep, ping #eng-infra with the error and include OS + screenshot. quick triage: 403 from internal pages usually means SSO or missing VPN. If you ping @kai we can check certs quickly.
maya: will do — thanks everyone, feeling less lost :relieved:
jordan (people-ops): we also added a quick section to the onboarding doc about channel routing and bot prefs: https://intra.redwood/onboarding/channels. welcome aboard!
